instruction: Tool paths: Archicad 27 launcher: C:\Program Files\Graphisoft\Archicad 27\Archicad Starter.exe; OpenStudio 3.10.0 CLI: C:\openstudio-3.10.0\bin\openstudio.exe. Two-stage workflow: this task starts from the provided seed file C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc. Do not start from a blank or unrelated model. You must complete the work in exactly two dependent software stages, in this order; do not skip stages, reorder stages, or generate the final package from scratch in only one tool. Stage 1 - Archicad CLI/API: open C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc in the Archicad command-line/API environment, preserve the seed model baseline unless the case text explicitly asks for a change, perform the BIM authoring work, and export C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1.ifc as the BIM intermediate result. During this same Archicad stage, derive C:\Users\user\Desktop\handoff.json from stage1.ifc and save C:\Users\user\Desktop\native_stage_log.json with the Archicad 27 executable identity and the raw JSON request/response for each native transaction. The handoff must include source_sha256 for stage1.ifc, software_stage or equivalent value archicad, the case id multi-cli-2-archicad-openstudio-task-04-windows, the required space names, thermal-zone names, and handoff tokens needed by OpenStudio. Stage 2 - OpenStudio CLI/Ruby API: consume C:\Users\user\Desktop\handoff.json and use C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1.ifc only as the upstream BIM reference. Generate C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.osm, C:\Users\user\Desktop\workflow.osw, C:\Users\user\Desktop\weather.epw, C:\Users\user\Desktop\flow_report.json, and C:\Users\user\Desktop\model_summary.csv from that Archicad handoff, and run the workflow with OpenStudio CLI so run\eplusout.sql, run\eplusout.err, and run\eplusout.end are native EnergyPlus outputs. In addition to the named files, handoff.json must include spaces[] records with name, thermal_zone, floor_area_m2, door_count, window_count and BIM entity counts from stage1.ifc. flow_report.json must include consumed_handoff_sha256, osm_sha256, building_area_m2, room_count, thermal_zone_count, door_count, window_count, window_wall_ratio, surface_count, subsurface_count, weather_file, schedule_set, construction_set, openstudio_version, native output hashes, and the final OpenStudio CLI transaction. model_summary.csv must include columns case_id, space_name, thermal_zone, floor_area_m2, source_handoff_sha256, source_stage1_sha256, energy_use_kwh, and peak_load_w. The evaluator checks these structured values against stage1.ifc, handoff.json, result.osm, flow_report.json, model_summary.csv, and the native simulation outputs rather than accepting a standalone final CSV. flow_report.json must record the consumed handoff hash and the result.osm hash; model_summary.csv must record the consumed handoff hash for each exported space or thermal zone. The evaluator checks this file sequence: init.ifc -> stage1.ifc -> handoff.json -> result.osm/workflow.osw/flow_report.json/model_summary.csv/run outputs. Outputs are invalid if any delivered IFC, JSON, OSM, CSV, SQL, ERR, or END file is directly created, rewritten, copied, patched, or post-processed outside the appropriate Archicad or OpenStudio software stage. The model is a light industrial shell with a workshop bay, loading side, and service access wall. The owner needs a BIM-to-OpenStudio package for parcel pickup corner envelope handoff. Add a PARCEL-PICKUP support corner near the loading side and add a SERVICE-DOOR record without changing the industrial shell footprint. The OpenStudio model should carry distinct thermal zones for WORKSHOP-ZN, PARCEL-PICKUP-ZN with schedules and load assumptions consistent with those uses. Keep the space names WORKSHOP, PARCEL-PICKUP and mark coordinated BIM and handoff data with revision code EW2A04.
